title: [CQ-V01a] Protected check definition shape
definitionOfDone: validateExecutionContract accepts valid requiredChecks losslessly (normalized paths, first-seen dedupe, empty lists omitted) and refuses each invalid shape with INVALID_INPUT naming the exact field. Invalid shapes: over 20 definitions, a bad or duplicate id, a blank, multiline or oversized command, an unnormalized, glob, absolute or traversal path, over 50 paths, an unknown key. Proven by new vitest cases.

submit_plan accepts executionContract.requiredChecks through its inputSchema and persists it. A resubmission that changes only requiredChecks advances planRevision, and an identical resubmission does not. Proven by new vitest cases.

definitionDigest is deterministic: equal definitions give the same digest, and any changed id, command or path gives a different one. protectedPaths returns the sorted, deduplicated union with each path's kind. Proven by unit tests.
Contracts without requiredChecks are unchanged: the existing F03 contract tests pass unmodified.
Fresh `cd packages/moe-daemon && npm test` exits 0 and its output is supplied to complete_task.
taskRails: No direct .moe edits; no Git-write commands by agents; wrappers own landing.
Do not enable verified-local or claim isolation until all requisite implementation and certification gates pass.

comments.content: Superseded by task-72efb0b663ec4b3da35a685ebb30ed34 (same title and scope), and archived before any work. Two DoD items here contradicted the code. DoD 2 said an identical resubmission does not advance planRevision, but derivePlanRevision advances it on every PLAN_SUBMITTED. DoD 4 said the existing F03 tests pass unmodified, but state/executionContract.test.ts pins the exact allowlist (FIELDS and the submit_plan schema parity check), and DoD 1-2 put requiredChecks inside the contract. The replacement proves materiality through updateTask writes, and allows only allowlist extensions.
